correctness.rationale: PASS: The 21 vertices, 105 one-faces and 105 two-faces of matching complex M7 give Euler characteristic 21; Bouc’s established reduced H1(M7;Z)=Z/3 yields free H2 rank20. The Shareshian–Wachs low-degree explicit torsion generator z=(12-13)∧(45-46) changes sign under the transposition (23); one-dimensional F3 Tor quotient therefore has S7 sign action. Every oriented 2-simplex consists of three disjoint edges; the odd transposition exchanging endpoints of one edge fixes all three matching-complex vertices, hence fixes that oriented simplex positively. A sign-vector in C2 over F3 would have each coordinate a=-a, forcing a=0, and the submodule H2(F3)=ker∂2 (no C3) contains no sign copy. Thus the canonical equivariant UCT short exact sequence with sign quotient cannot split. Its dimensions are 20→21→1. The source checker’s finite rank method was inspected, but the stabilizer obstruction is an exact all-facets argument, not a numeric assertion based on VERIFY_OK.
